name: handoff
description: Direct bot-to-bot handoff. /handoff (bare-only, inline buttons: Now / After this task / Ping pong / File only) relays work to an idle peer: handoff file in <repo>/.handoff/ → agent-bus prompt with explicit file path → two-way ACK → sender self-reset (rename done-…, /new idle). Proactive context-threshold trigger (1M→35%, 200k→75%). Replaces /handoff-resume.
